text: Shot dead in a Chicago toy store, the strangler Charles Lee Ray [casts a voodoo spell to pour his soul into a talking doll|origin|deliberately called up]. Widowed Karen Barclay [buys that doll from a peddler for her son Andy's sixth birthday|trigger|bringing something home]. The doll calls itself Chucky and tells Andy its real name, and soon the babysitter falls from a window. Nobody believes Andy, while the doll [plans to move its soul into the boy|wants|a way into life] while it still can, and its one weakness is [the heart hidden in its body|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
